# Third-party notices

Vitrine includes the following third-party components. This file is generated by
`scripts/generate-notices.js` from the installed packages; run `npm run notices` after
changing a dependency.

| Component | Version | License | Used for | Shipped in |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [highlight.js](https://github.com/highlightjs/highlight.js) | 11.12.0 | BSD-3-Clause | Syntax highlighting | Library bundle and dist/languages/ |
| [marked](https://github.com/markedjs/marked) | 18.1.3 | MIT | Markdown parsing (GFM) | Library bundle |
| [DOMPurify](https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify) | 3.4.17 | Apache-2.0 OR MPL-2.0 | HTML sanitization | Library bundle |
| [Lucide](https://lucide.dev) | 1.52.0 | ISC; icons derived from Feather: MIT | Interface icons | Library bundle (src/core/icons.js) |
| [Apache ECharts](https://github.com/apache/echarts) | 6.1.0 | Apache-2.0 | Charts drawn by `<vt-chart>` | dist/vendor/echarts.js, loaded by `<vt-chart>` only |
| [ZRender](https://github.com/ecomfe/zrender) | 6.1.0 | BSD-3-Clause | Canvas rendering engine of Apache ECharts | dist/vendor/echarts.js, loaded by `<vt-chart>` only |
| [js-yaml](https://github.com/nodeca/js-yaml) | 5.5.0 | MIT | YAML reading for `<vt-openapi>` | dist/vendor/yaml.js, loaded by `<vt-openapi>` for YAML only |
| [Temml](https://github.com/ronkok/Temml) | 0.14.0 | MIT | TeX to MathML for `<vt-math>` | dist/vendor/temml.js, loaded by `<vt-math>` only; its MathML rules in src/styles/math.css |
| [Font Awesome Free](https://fontawesome.com) | 7.3.1 | Icons: CC-BY-4.0; code: MIT | Solid, regular and brand icons of `<vt-icon-picker>` | dist/vendor/icons/fa-*.js, loaded by `<vt-icon-picker>` only |
| [Lucide (icon set)](https://lucide.dev) | 1.73.0 | ISC; icons derived from Feather: MIT | Lucide icons of `<vt-icon-picker>` | dist/vendor/icons/lucide.js, loaded by `<vt-icon-picker>` only |
| [Bootstrap Icons](https://icons.getbootstrap.com) | 1.13.2 | MIT | Bootstrap icons of `<vt-icon-picker>` | dist/vendor/icons/bootstrap.js, loaded by `<vt-icon-picker>` only |
| [flag-icons](https://github.com/lipis/flag-icons) | 7.6.0 | MIT | Country flags of `<vt-icon-picker>` | dist/vendor/icons/flags.js, loaded by `<vt-icon-picker>` only |
| [Mermaid](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid) | 12.3.0 | MIT | Diagrams drawn by `<vt-diagram>` | dist/vendor/mermaid.js and dist/vendor/mermaid/, loaded by `<vt-diagram>` only |
| [Mermaid parser](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid) | 2.0.1 | MIT | Diagram syntax (Mermaid) | dist/vendor/mermaid.js and dist/vendor/mermaid/, loaded by `<vt-diagram>` only |
| [D3](https://github.com/d3/d3) | 7.9.2 | ISC | Drawing and layout (Mermaid) | dist/vendor/mermaid.js and dist/vendor/mermaid/, loaded by `<vt-diagram>` only |
| [d3-sankey](https://github.com/d3/d3-sankey) | 0.12.3 | BSD-3-Clause | Sankey diagrams (Mermaid) | dist/vendor/mermaid.js and dist/vendor/mermaid/, loaded by `<vt-diagram>` only |
| [dagre-d3-es](https://github.com/tbo47/dagre-es) | 7.0.14 | MIT | Graph layout (Mermaid) | dist/vendor/mermaid.js and dist/vendor/mermaid/, loaded by `<vt-diagram>` only |
| [Cytoscape.js](https://github.com/cytoscape/cytoscape.js) | 3.35.0 | MIT | Mind map and architecture layout (Mermaid) | dist/vendor/mermaid.js and dist/vendor/mermaid/, loaded by `<vt-diagram>` only |
| [cytoscape-fcose](https://github.com/iVis-at-Bilkent/cytoscape.js-fcose) | 2.2.0 | MIT | Graph layout (Mermaid) | dist/vendor/mermaid.js and dist/vendor/mermaid/, loaded by `<vt-diagram>` only |
| [cytoscape-cose-bilkent](https://github.com/cytoscape/cytoscape.js-cose-bilkent) | 4.1.0 | MIT | Graph layout (Mermaid) | dist/vendor/mermaid.js and dist/vendor/mermaid/, loaded by `<vt-diagram>` only |
| [layout-base](https://github.com/iVis-at-Bilkent/layout-base) | 1.0.2 | MIT | Graph layout (Mermaid) | dist/vendor/mermaid.js and dist/vendor/mermaid/, loaded by `<vt-diagram>` only |
| [cose-base](https://github.com/iVis-at-Bilkent/cose-base) | 1.0.3 | MIT | Graph layout (Mermaid) | dist/vendor/mermaid.js and dist/vendor/mermaid/, loaded by `<vt-diagram>` only |
